content.text:
`slugify` is now implemented in `src/strings.js`, and `npm test` passes all 10 tests (the 2 existing ones plus 8 new ones).

It strips diacritics and turns `đ`/`Đ` into `d`. It lowercases, turns each run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 into one hyphen, and trims leading hyphens. It then cuts to 50 characters and removes any trailing hyphen, so a cut can't leave one at the end.

The new tests are in `test/strings.test.js`. They cover:
- basic input
- Vietnamese text including `đ`
- other Latin accents
- runs of symbols
- trimming
- input with no letters or digits, which gives an empty string
- the 50-character cut, including the case where the cut lands on a hyphen
